name: adaptive-eval-corpus-integrity
title: feat(eval): manifest 指纹 + out-of-band 校验 + 可选加盐假名（票 5ck）
description: 落实独立审查两条低危：1) 抽取器在写 manifest.json 时同时写 manifest.sha256（manifest 字节的 SHA-256）；gate 校验该指纹，并新增 --expect-manifest-sha256 供 out-of-band 核对，不匹配转红，报告输出实际指纹（文档如实说明只改 manifest 能被发现、成对重写需 out-of-band 值）。2) pseudonym 支持 HMAC 密钥（部署侧 XHS_EVAL_REDACTION_KEY，不写入语料），manifest 记录 pseudonym_mode=sha256|hmac；无密钥时保持兼容并打印可被字典攻击的警告。新增测试覆盖加盐稳定性/不同密钥不同假名/指纹校验与不匹配/out-of-band 期望值。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-11-02 (the two low-severity items the independent review left). 1) Tamper-evidence: the extractor now writes manifest.sha256 (SHA-256 of the manifest bytes) next to manifest.json, and run_gate verifies it; --expect-manifest-sha256 accepts the digest recorded out of band, which is the only thing that catches a *paired* rewrite of fixtures + manifest + digest. The docstring and plan say that limit explicitly instead of implying tamper-proofness. 2) Salted pseudonyms: pseudonym(kind, value, key) now produces an HMAC-SHA256 when a key is supplied; the extractor reads it from XHS_EVAL_REDACTION_KEY (--redaction-key-env is configurable) and never writes it into the corpus; the manifest records pseudonym_mode=sha256|hmac; without a key the extractor prints a warning that short account ids can be dictionary-attacked. Stable under a fixed key so corpora stay comparable; changing the key makes old corpora incomparable, which the plan documents. Tests: keyed pseudonym stability and key-independence, salted extraction records hmac + writes a matching digest, unsalted extraction records sha256, a hand-edited manifest is caught by the detached digest, and an out-of-band digest catches a paired rewrite (the in-corpus checks stay green in that scenario, which is exactly why the out-of-band value exists). Verification: test_eval_fixtures 17 passed, test_eval_gate 25 passed, tests/unit/scripts 176 passed, ruff clean, ci_local lint/format PASS, full suite in the journal.
